title: EscapeGravity — Science Board Game for Kids 7+
description: A physical science board game where kids race to the International Space Station by beating gravity. 35+ real physical challenges, 13 forces to master, 2-6 players, about 30 minutes a game. Comes with 11+ real play objects — toy cars, clay, a frisbee, balls and more — plus 100% original hand-drawn artwork. Zero screens. Made in small batches in India for ages 7 to grandparents.
